name: Get the list of object records and total records count for an object.
description: Get the list of object records and total records count for an object.. Custom objects are only available to Enterprise plans. This feature is in beta. These are subject to change. This API retrieves a list of object records along with their associated records and provides the total count of records for the specified object. **Note**: Contact as object type is not supported in this endpoint.

object_type.description: Object type for the records to retrieve. Must be a previously created custom object type. Contact as object type is not supported in this endpoint.

limit.description: Number of records returned per page

page_num.description: Page number for pagination. It's used to fetch the object records on a provided page number. Must be a valid positive integer.

sort.title: ObjectsObjectTypeRecordsGetParametersSort
sort.description: Sort order, must be 'asc' or 'desc'. Default to 'desc' if not provided.

association.title: ObjectsObjectTypeRecordsGetParametersAssociation
association.description: Whether to include associations, must be 'true' or 'false'. Default to 'false' if not provided.

count.description: Total number of object records for an object type.

associations.description: List of associations for the object record. If association query param is true it will return 5 associated records per association.

attributes.description:
Key-value pairs of attribute data for the object record. Each key is the attribute **key** (e.g., `company_name`, `engine_type`), not the attribute label (e.g., "Company Name", "Engine Type"). Only attributes that already exist in the object schema will be present.
For `category` or `multiple_category` attributes, the value is the option **key** (not the option label or option ID).
